task1: Compare separately calibrated WIN/TOP3 vs normalized WIN and implied marginals from legacy geometric strength.
Compare market-corrected shared-strength WIN/TOP3 vs observations and market-only baseline.
Keep raw prediction error distinct from marginal distortion caused by joint rank conversion.
fit_data: 2025 all-race raw predictions from saved reconstructed base models trained through 2024. Market calibration uses the same 119 complete flat graded races and fixed exclusions as the previous experiment.
base_calibration_policy: For each 2025 fold, refit Platt WIN/TOP3 on all available 2025 races through the fold train_end only. Do not reuse the Platt calibrator fitted on all of 2025 inside fold validation. Final refit uses all 2025. Base LightGBM remains trained through 2024 for 2025 predictions.

shared_ai_market.scores: a log(sqrt(WIN*TOP3))+b log(q), shared at all 3 ranks

stage_two_heads.scores: stage1 a1 log(WIN)+b1 log(q); stage2/3 a23 log(TOP3)+b2/b3 log(q)

optimizer: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient; deterministic fixed starts, verify convergence. Coefficients not selected for ROI.
selection: Choose lowest-complexity method whose pooled 2025 forward-validation ordered-top3 mean logloss is within one standard error of the best mean; tie-break lower mean then name. Standard error computed over validation races. The prior shared_ai_market method is a prespecified incumbent.
evaluation: After freezing method and coefficients using 2025 only, evaluate the selected family and all prespecified fixed families on 2026-01-04 through 2026-10-18. Report all results; do not reselect or retune from 2026.
evaluation_warning: 2026 outcomes were previously inspected for bias and the previous correction. Treat this as a retrospective temporal comparison, not a new independent prospective holdout.
metrics: ordered-top3 and each rank conditional logloss
fixed-allocation selected-method and incumbent portfolio official ROI and hit calibration
joint_probability_policy: Use exact rank-dependent conditional permutations, derive all horse/pair/triple marginals and union coverage from that same distribution. No ad-hoc independent probability rescaling.
allocation: Preserve balanced_A_v3 objective/constraints/default solver settings; adapt only ordered-outcome probability input. Original budgets and old records unchanged.
limits: Final odds and final starter sets; original full archive point-in-time validity uncertified.
Some 2026 races use verified checkpoints or public reconstruction, as documented in previous audit.
Finite samples and approximate MILP; no profit guarantee.
No deployment, automation change, X sending or ticket purchases in this run.
